coverage_notes: Angle: Duke-alumni operator-angels. Broad discovery queries ('Duke' + 'angel investor' + founder/AI/fintech; 'angel investors including' + Duke) returned mostly directory or list pages and were unproductive, so most of the budget went on named leads, each checked with one or two searches. Fetching entrepreneurship.duke.edu and thekeyexecutives.com (the 'Top 100 Duke Alumni in Technology' list) was blocked by the proxy; only search snippets were used. A list snippet named Naval Ravikant and Sam Altman as Duke alumni; this is unreliable and was not used. One result title contained an instruction aimed at AI tools; it was ignored. Recency caveat: Tracxn, CB Insights and Signal snippets are aggregator data; deal dates are as the snippets give them. No emails were published by any of these people, so every email is 'not found'. Not searched for lack of budget: Yunha Kim (Simple Habit), Kal Vepuri (Hero Health; healthcare), Tom Dixon (Yext co-founder), Mike Doernberg (ReverbNation), Drew Schiller (Validic), Lila Ibrahim (Google DeepMind COO; Duke MBA unverified), and Duke-alum executives at Stripe, Robinhood, Coinbase, Ramp and Anthropic (one generic query found none). Watch: Brad Lightcap (Duke, ex-OpenAI COO) left in Aug 2026 to start an undisclosed venture; if it is a fund, he becomes a top target.
